names.form: Αγίες Θέκλα, Μαριάμνη, Μάρθα, Μαρία και Ενναθά οι πέντε κανονικές Παρθένες

names.note: Read out of «Αγίες Θέκλα, Μαριάμνη, Μάρθα, Μαρία και Ενναθά οι πέντε κανονικές Παρθένες» in this folder’s Greek citation.
Her own name, read out of doxologia.ro's line for 9 iunie, «Sfânta Muceniță Marta».
The name as name page 2608 gives it, «Марфа Персидская, мц.», with the grade taken off. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: it has no other holder.

death.note: saint.gr, 9 June: „Στα χρόνια του βασιλιά των Περσών Σαθωρίου (330 μ.Χ.)”; the heading prints „(; - 330)”.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 июня ст. ст. — «Мцц. Феклы , Марфы и Марии Персидских (346).»

attestations.note: She is the second of the three the line names. The day's fifth entry names three of the five virgins together, «Мцц. Феклы , Марфы и Марии Персидских (346).», and the corpus keeps all five; `mariamne-of-aza` and `ennatha-of-aza` are therefore folders this day page does not print and they took nothing. The /Life/ page behind the line is one sentence long and the whole of what this calendar tells: «Святые мученицы Фекла, Марфа и Мария 6 июня 346 года усечены мечом за Христа при царе Сапоре II в Персии.» — beheaded on 6 June 346 under Shapur II. Two things in that sentence are new and neither was written into `dates`: the year 346, where this folder holds about 330 off the Romanian and Greek pages, and the day of the death, 6 June, which is three days before the feast. Both are recorded in the life and the interval is left as it stands, because a third calendar's year is a reading for the author and not a day's work. The name page links a Pravoslavie.Ru article headed «Святые девы Фекла, Мариамна, Марфа, Мария и Еннафа», which names all five and the Tamshapur of their passion, and NOT ONE WORD of it was read. The day page prints no hymn for them. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 9 iunie — «Sfânta Muceniță Marta»

attestations.note: doxologia.ro's list for 9 iunie prints the five names of this company one after another — «Sfânta Muceniță Mariamni», «Sfânta Muceniță Tecla», «Sfânta Muceniță Maria», «Sfânta Muceniţă Enata», «Sfânta Muceniță Marta» — each on its own line and each with a page that carries no life. The company is identified by the set of five names, not by any one of them; the Romanian calendar keeps them on 9 June where the Greek keeps them on 26 September (read 24 September 2026).

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 26 Σεπτεμβρίου — «Αγίες Θέκλα, Μαριάμνη, Μάρθα, Μαρία και Ενναθά οι πέντε κανονικές Παρθένες»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs’s page for 26. септембар ст. ст. (civil 9 October) was not read (2026-09-17).
